title: Coordinatewise vector sharing
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k>0$, let $\iota$ be an index type, and let $v$ assign a field element to each index and $q$ assign a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$ to each index. For any fixed $x\in\iota$, the shares at coordinate $x$ produced by the vector Shamir scheme form a sharing of $v(x)$ with degree bound less than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: Each $q(x)$ is a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$
